_help: The small guide window (UIContentsGuide.img/Minimum): the GUIDE popup with one card. x/y = the top-left of the window in 1366x768 game pixels (the window is 135x115, the art size, so the size stays in the code). titleH = the height of the strip that drags the window. cardX/cardY = the spot of the card picture. maxX/maxY = the spot of the green plus (it opens the big guide window), closeX/closeY = the spot of the X. leftX/rightX = the spot of the two arrows, arrowY = their top. dotX/dotY = the spot of the first dot, dotPitch = the gap between the dots, dotW/dotH = the size of the dot row.
